const lua = `
local function readfile(p) local f=assert(io.open(p,"rb")); local s=f:read("*a"); f:close(); return s end
local function gitbase() local p=assert(io.popen("git show ece7c2cf1615bbee68e92f99ff14db88feb3e1ab:tome-cults.lua","r")); local s=p:read("*a"); assert(p:close()); return s end
local function stable(v) if type(v)~="table" then return tostring(v) end local x={} for i=1,#v do x[#x+1]=stable(v[i]) end return "{"..table.concat(x,",").."}" end
local function collect(src)
 local out,sec={},nil; local env=setmetatable({}, {__index=_G}); env.section=function(s) sec=s end
 env.t=function(source,target,tag,special) out[#out+1]={section=sec,source=source,target=target,tag=tag,special=stable(special)} end
 local fn=assert(loadstring(src)); setfenv(fn,env); fn(); return out
end
local function shape(s) local x={} for suffix in s:gmatch("\\n(\\t*)") do x[#x+1]=#suffix end return table.concat(x,",").."|trail="..tostring(s:sub(-1)=="\\n") end
local b,c=collect(gitbase()),collect(readfile("tome-cults.lua")); assert(#b==#c); local n=0
for i=1,#b do
 assert(b[i].section==c[i].section and b[i].source==c[i].source and b[i].tag==c[i].tag and b[i].special==c[i].special,"non-target change at "..i)
 if b[i].target~=c[i].target then n=n+1; assert(shape(c[i].source)==shape(c[i].target),"line shape mismatch at "..i) end
end
assert(n==26,"target changes="..n); print(("OK records=%d target_changes=%d non_target_changes=0 line_shapes_match=26"):format(#c,n))
`;
